turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
end a tracking number?

Orders usually begin processing on business days, Monday through Friday, and orders placed after 12 PM EST start processing the next business day. Once your order ships, you’ll get a shipping confirmation email with your tracking number, and tracking can take up to 24-48 hours to show movement on the carrier’s site.

If you placed your order a few days ago and want me to check your specific order, send your order number or the email used at checkout and I’ll look into it.

Once your order ships, delivery depends on the shipping method selected. Tracking usually starts updating within 24-48 hours after the carrier receives it. Processing can take 1-5 business days before shipment begins.

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
to speed it up if I need it sooner?

If your order is already processing, I’m not able to speed up the shipping method on that order. The fastest option is to place a new order with your preferred shipping speed, then return the original once it arrives.

If your order was just placed, there may still be a chance to cancel it and reorder with faster shipping. Send your order number or the email used at checkout, and I’ll check that for you. Let me know if there’s anything more I can assist with.

How do I find my tracking link?

You can find your tracking link in 2 places:

Your shipping confirmation email, titled “Your Spanx.com order has shipped”
Your SPANX account under Order History

Once the order ships, click the tracking number to open the carrier’s tracking page. If you don’t see the email, check your spam or junk folder too.

If you want, send your order number or checkout email and I’ll help you track it down.

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
ess?

Once an order is processing or has shipped, we’re not able to reroute it to a different address from our side.

If it’s already shipped, check the tracking link, the carrier may offer delivery options there, or you can contact the carrier directly.

If it hasn’t shipped yet, send your order number or the email used at checkout and I’ll check whether there’s still time to cancel it so you can place a new order with the correct address. Let me know if there’s anything more I can assist with.
